prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: A child safely baking with an adult in a cozy kitchen, cake, chocolate and utensils. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Happy Kitchen". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Kitchen, sugar, chocolate, cream.
Candy, doughnut, one happy dream.
Bake one cake and add some salt.
Cut with care, keep the knife safe.
Fork and spoon beside the cup.
Smell the cake and taste the love.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
